approved_draft.why_this_matters: What counts as an ordinary opinion shifts underneath people, so positions they would once have rejected outright arrive already sounding moderate.
approved_draft.what_it_is_not: Public opinion moves on its own and always has, and arguing for a position most people currently reject is how every reform has started. A single extreme statement is not a repositioning campaign — this describes drift visible only in aggregate and in hindsight.
